info.brief: Functions for interacting with the YouTube Playables SDK.
info.description: Functions for interacting with the YouTube Playables SDK.

elements.name: playables.is_in_playables_env
elements.description: Returns whether the SDK reports that the game is running in the Playables environment. Returns false if the SDK is not loaded.

returnvalues.name: in_playables_env
returnvalues.doc: True when the SDK is loaded and IN_PLAYABLES_ENV is true, otherwise false.

elements.name: playables.get_sdk_version
elements.description: Returns the loaded YouTube Playables SDK version, or nil if it is unavailable.

returnvalues.name: sdk_version
returnvalues.doc: The value of SDK_VERSION, or nil if the SDK or its version is unavailable.

elements.name: playables.game_ready
elements.description: Notifies YouTube that the loading screen is gone and the game is ready for players to interact with. The extension automatically calls firstFrameReady() during initialization.

elements.name: playables.load_data
elements.description: Loads serialized game data from YouTube. Only one load request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another load_data() request.

elements.name: playables.save_data
elements.description: Saves valid UTF-8 text to YouTube, with a maximum size of 3 MiB. Invalid UTF-8 returns false and an error through the callback before the SDK is called. Base64-encode binary data such as sys.serialize() output before saving. Only one save request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another save_data() request.

parameters.name: data
parameters.doc: The serialized game data as valid UTF-8 text. Embedded zero bytes are supported.

elements.name: playables.is_audio_enabled
elements.description: Returns whether game audio is enabled in the player's YouTube settings. Use this to initialize the game audio state.

returnvalues.name: is_audio_enabled
returnvalues.doc: True when game audio is enabled.

elements.name: playables.on_audio_enabled_change
elements.description: Registers a callback for YouTube audio-setting changes. Before the callback runs, the extension automatically mutes the master sound group when audio is disabled, or unmutes it when audio is enabled and the game is not paused. A new callback replaces the previous one. Pass nil to unregister it. This function cannot be called from its own callback.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: The event callback, or nil to unregister the current callback.

elements.name: playables.on_pause
elements.description: Registers a callback for YouTube pause events. The extension automatically mutes the master sound group before the callback runs. A new callback replaces the previous one. Pass nil to unregister it. This function cannot be called from its own callback. A paused game is not guaranteed to resume.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: The event callback, or nil to unregister the current callback.

elements.name: playables.on_resume
elements.description: Registers a callback for YouTube resume events. Before the callback runs, the extension automatically unmutes the master sound group if YouTube audio is enabled, or keeps it muted if audio is disabled. A new callback replaces the previous one. Pass nil to unregister it. This function cannot be called from its own callback.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: The event callback, or nil to unregister the current callback.

elements.name: playables.get_language
elements.description: Gets the language in the player's YouTube settings as a BCP-47 language tag. Only one request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another get_language() request.

elements.name: playables.send_score
elements.description: Sends an integer score to YouTube. Use one consistent score dimension across the game. Only one request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another send_score() request.

parameters.name: score
parameters.doc: An integer no greater than JavaScript's maximum safe integer.

elements.name: playables.open_yt_content
elements.description: Requests that YouTube open a video or another Playable. The content type is optional and defaults to CONTENT_TYPE_VIDEO. Only one request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another open_yt_content() request.

parameters.name: content_id
parameters.doc: The YouTube video or Playable ID.

elements.name: playables.request_interstitial_ad
elements.description: Requests an interstitial ad. Success does not guarantee that an ad was shown. Do not use this API to grant rewards. Only one interstitial request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another request_interstitial_ad() request. Keep handling YouTube audio, pause, and resume events during ads.

elements.name: playables.request_rewarded_ad
elements.description: Requests a rewarded ad. Grant a reward only when reward_earned is true. Only one rewarded request may be in progress at a time. The request remains in progress until its callback returns, so the callback cannot start another request_rewarded_ad() request. Keep handling YouTube audio, pause, and resume events during ads.

parameters.name: reward_id
parameters.doc: A stable ID unique to the reward type. Reuse it for each offer of that reward and do not include user data.

elements.name: playables.log_error
elements.description: Reports an error occurrence to YouTube. Takes no arguments and returns no value. Reporting is best-effort and rate-limited, so delivery is not guaranteed.

elements.name: playables.log_warning
elements.description: Reports a warning occurrence to YouTube. Takes no arguments and returns no value. Reporting is best-effort and rate-limited, so delivery is not guaranteed.
